title: maint.event.v1{kind=spool_entry_retired_kind}
description: Phase 8 §8.13.3 — emitted (as sec.alert.v1) when spool-flush quarantines a spool entry because its kind is no longer in KNOWN_MAINT_EVENT_KINDS or its schema_version is below cfg.swarm_min_supported_schema_version. Notification only. The envelope is moved to spool_dir/.retired/ with a <request_id>.retired.json sidecar.

produced_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this notification was emitted.

target.description: Agent name owning the spool (e.g. 'maint.scaler.v1') or 'opsctl' for the opsctl spool.

request_id.description: request_id extracted from the quarantined envelope payload.

entry_kind.description: The kind field of the quarantined envelope.

reason.description: Why the envelope was quarantined: 'unknown_kind' = kind not in KNOWN_MAINT_EVENT_KINDS; 'schema_outdated' = schema_version below cfg.swarm_min_supported_schema_version.

current_version.description: Swarm component version at quarantine time (informational).

retired_at_version.description: Swarm component version at quarantine time (informational; same as current_version).
